title: 曾喊买铜最佳交易：如今却说还没见底，柯里盯住中国溢价
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: What's been coming wrong with copper?
And we have a liquidity crisis going on. You see it in dollar funding rates.
segments.zh: 我们正经历流动性变化，从美元融资利率可见一斑。

segments.en: And what that implies is you sell the things you can not the things you want to.
segments.zh: 这意味着你卖出能卖的，而非想卖的。

segments.en: And the reason why you end up with them selling the things you can is because when you look at metals and I put gold in this camp too,
segments.zh: 之所以会卖出能卖的，是因为看金属市场，我把黄金也算在内，

segments.en: they're very easy to store. And you can liquidate them. They're very hard to transport.
segments.zh: 它们易于储存，可以变现，但很难运输。

segments.en: And so when you have these liquidity crisis hit, the first thing you do is you sell things like gold.
segments.zh: 所以当流动性变化来袭，首先会卖出黄金这类资产。

segments.en: The one that usually gets hits the hardest copper as well.
segments.zh: 通常受冲击最重的还有铜。

segments.en: And they typically just go all the way down until you finally get a pivot out of the policy makers to inject some liquidity back in the system.
segments.zh: 它们通常会一路下跌，直到政策制定者转向向系统注入流动性。

segments.en: Why is it up a little bit today and everything reprieve? The market is trying to take out that rate height, that 50 basis rate height to a certain degree.
segments.zh: 为何今天小幅上涨、一切暂缓？市场在试图消化那次利率高点，某种程度上是50个基点的高点。

segments.en: And that's why we're up today. But I don't think we're there.
segments.zh: 这就是今天上涨的原因，但我认为还没到那一步。

segments.en: A policy maker communicate that. And when that happens, I'm back being long copper and long gold.
segments.zh: 政策制定者传达这一点。当这种情况发生时，我会重新做多铜和黄金。

segments.en: Why? You saw the premium in China.
segments.zh: 为什么？你看到了中国的溢价。

segments.en: It was, you know, regional time high last week, which tells you the fundamental stories are still there.
segments.zh: 上周创下地区新高，这说明基本面故事依然存在。

segments.en: We just have this liquidity crisis. Just to clarify, was that a when that happens or if that happens?
segments.zh: 我们只是遇到了这种流动性变化。澄清一下，是当这种情况发生时，还是如果这种情况发生？

segments.en: I would say win. I can't hear some reason why I'm going to say win.
segments.zh: 我会说“当”。我听不出什么理由让我说“如果”。

segments.en: Is the US economy is asset heavy now.
segments.zh: 美国经济现在资产较重。
